data.one_liner: Pure‑Flutter vector map widget that renders GeoJSON data.
data.what_it_does: It parses GeoJSON strings and displays them as interactive vector maps. The map can be styled, layered, and annotated with markers, legends, and hover effects.
use_when: You need a lightweight, fully Flutter‑based map without native SDKs or WebViews
You want to visualise custom GeoJSON data with custom theming and interactivity
avoid_when: You require satellite imagery, street maps, or routing features
You need platform‑specific map SDKs with offline tiles
strengths: No native platform dependencies – works on all Flutter targets
Highly customizable theming and rule‑based styling
Supports multi‑layer maps and interactive features like hover and click
weaknesses: Limited to vector data – no raster tiles or built‑in map providers
Feature set smaller than full‑featured map SDKs (e.g., no built‑in geocoding)

alternatives.name: flutter_map
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides raster tile support and extensive plugins for markers, clustering, and offline maps

alternatives.name: google_maps_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers Google Maps tiles, street view, and built‑in place search

alternatives.name: geolocator
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need location services without rendering a map
